column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: Look at the desert drown,\nIsaac. Your lighthouse\ndid this. I only watch.{end_wait}
Jenna, wait! Whatever\nthey did to you, we can\nundo it. Come back!{end_wait}
Undo it? Sweet Isaac.\nThe girl you want is\nash on the wind.{end_wait}
Keep climbing your\nlighthouses. I will be\nwarm when they are lit.{end_wait}
